servers.name: Kaggle Notebooks

limits.quota_notes: Kaggle documents a weekly GPU quota of 30 hours or sometimes higher depending on demand and available resources. Actual quota is account- and resource-dependent.

start_notes: Sign in and create or open a notebook.
Enable an available accelerator only when training requires it.
Check the current GPU quota in Kaggle before starting.
Save checkpoints to persistent external storage; notebook runtime storage is not the checkpoint authority.

servers.name: Google Colab

limits.quota_notes: Free-tier runtimes can run for at most 12 hours, depending on availability and usage patterns. GPU availability and usage limits vary; Google does not promise a fixed free GPU quota.

start_notes: Open the notebook in Colab and select an available runtime.
GPU access is not guaranteed on the free tier.
Expect disconnections and resume from the last verified checkpoint.
Do not use paid compute or purchase compute units.

servers.name: Lightning AI Studios

limits.quota_notes: The Free plan lists one active free Studio with 4-hour restarts and a limited amount of free credits. GPU hours depend on hardware, credits and availability; do not assume GPU compute is free.

start_notes: Use only compute explicitly shown as free and available in the account.
Do not enable pay-as-you-go, add a payment method, or select paid hardware.
Plan for a Studio restart after 4 hours and resume from checkpoint.
Skip this server if the free allocation is unavailable or unclear.

servers.name: Hugging Face Spaces CPU Basic

limits.quota_notes: CPU Basic is listed as 2 vCPU, 16 GB RAM and 50 GB non-persistent disk at no hourly hardware cost. Confirm account and Space eligibility before relying on it. This is a slow CPU fallback, not a GPU server.

start_notes: Use only CPU Basic hardware; do not upgrade to paid hardware.
Confirm the account permits the required compute Space before setup.
Treat local Space disk as temporary and upload verified checkpoints externally.
Use for validation or short CPU runs rather than expecting GPU training speed.
